interfaces.name: Deck
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Deck { var id: UUID; var name: String; var createdAt: Date; var isArchived: Bool; var isDemo: Bool; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade) var cards: [Card] }
interfaces.notes: SwiftData @Model class — binding version. No @Attribute(.unique). A plain Codable Deck/Card behind an async repository protocol was proposed and rejected: it can't satisfy the already-locked #Predicate/batched-fetch constraints.

interfaces.name: Card
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Card { var id: UUID; var front: String; var back: String; var note: String?; var deck: Deck?; var easeFactor: Double; var intervalDays: Int; var repetitions: Int; var nextReviewDate: Date; var isDemo: Bool; var lastGradeRaw: Int? }
interfaces.notes: isDemo denormalized from deck for #Predicate filtering. Cards never move between decks — no moveCard function exists anywhere in this contract, intentionally.

interfaces.name: DueQueryService
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor final class DueQueryService { func dueCounts(scope: ReviewScope, context: ModelContext, clock: Clock) -> [PersistentIdentifier: Int]; func dueCards(scope: ReviewScope, context: ModelContext, clock: Clock) -> [Card] }
interfaces.notes: Single shared due-query surface; dueCounts is one grouped FetchDescriptor per call, never per-row. dueCards builds the one-shot Review session snapshot — synchronous, a local SwiftData fetch, not async.

interfaces.name: SessionEngine
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor final class SessionEngine { init(queue: [Card], clock: Clock); private(set) var index: Int; private(set) var isFinished: Bool; func gradeCurrent(_ grade: Grade, context: ModelContext); func summary() -> SessionSummary }
interfaces.notes: Owns the captured snapshot array; never re-queries via @Query. Again-graded cards are not requeued within the session.

interfaces.name: Clock
interfaces.signature: protocol Clock: Sendable { func now() -> Date; var calendar: Calendar { get } }
interfaces.notes: RecallCore. SystemClock default; TestClock and DebugOffsetClock (app-side, DEBUG-only) also conform.

interfaces.name: SystemClock
interfaces.signature: struct SystemClock: Clock { func now() -> Date; var calendar: Calendar }
interfaces.notes: Uses Date() and Calendar.current.

interfaces.name: TestClock
interfaces.signature: struct TestClock: Clock { var fixedNow: Date; var calendar: Calendar; func now() -> Date { fixedNow } }
interfaces.notes: Used in RecallCoreTests for deterministic DST/day-boundary/backward-clock-jump tests.

interfaces.name: Grade
interfaces.signature: enum Grade: Int, Sendable, CaseIterable { case again = 0, hard = 1, good = 2, easy = 3 }
interfaces.notes: Pure RecallCore enum. SwiftData models store the rawValue as Int, never this enum directly.

interfaces.name: CardSchedule
interfaces.signature: struct CardSchedule: Equatable, Sendable { var easeFactor: Double; var intervalDays: Int; var repetitions: Int; var nextReviewDate: Date }
interfaces.notes: Pure value type; app layer maps this to/from Card's stored properties.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine.schedule
interfaces.signature: enum SM2Engine { static func schedule(current: CardSchedule, grade: Grade, now: Date, clock: Clock) -> CardSchedule }
interfaces.notes: Implements the locked formula table: ease floor 1.3, Hard = interval*1.2 fixed multiplier, Good = interval*ease, Easy = interval*ease*1.3, Again resets repetitions/interval and ease -= 0.20.

interfaces.name: DueComputation.isDue
interfaces.signature: enum DueComputation { static func isDue(_ schedule: CardSchedule, on date: Date, using clock: Clock) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: The single shared due predicate: calendar.startOfDay(nextReviewDate) <= calendar.startOfDay(date). Every screen/service calls this, never reimplements it.

interfaces.name: CSVParser.parse
interfaces.signature: enum CSVParser { static func parse(_ data: Data, existingPairs: Set<CSVCardKey>) throws -> CSVParseResult }
interfaces.notes: RFC4180-compliant. Throws CSVImportError.notUTF8 or .tooManyRows(limit: 10_000); otherwise per-row results with duplicate-skip reasons.

interfaces.name: CSVParseResult
interfaces.signature: struct CSVParseResult: Sendable { var rows: [CSVRowResult]; var validCount: Int; var errorCount: Int; var duplicateCount: Int }

interfaces.name: CSVRowResult
interfaces.signature: struct CSVRowResult: Sendable, Identifiable { let id: Int; let rawLine: Int; let front: String; let back: String; let status: CSVRowStatus }

interfaces.name: CSVRowStatus
interfaces.signature: enum CSVRowStatus: Sendable { case valid; case duplicate; case malformed(reason: String) }

interfaces.name: CSVWriter.write
interfaces.signature: enum CSVWriter { static func write(cards: [(front: String, back: String)]) -> Data }
interfaces.notes: Two columns only, RFC4180 quoting; note field never included.

interfaces.name: ReviewLogEntry
interfaces.signature: @Model final class ReviewLogEntry { var id: UUID; var timestamp: Date; var gradeRaw: Int; var cardID: UUID; var deckID: UUID; var isDemo: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Durable per-grading-event history backing Stats charts and per-deck session attribution; Card alone only holds current state.

interfaces.name: GradeRecorder.record
interfaces.signature: enum GradeRecorder { @MainActor static func record(card: Card, grade: Grade, clock: Clock, context: ModelContext) throws }
interfaces.notes: Single call site: mutates Card's schedule via SM2Engine, inserts a ReviewLogEntry, calls context.save() synchronously. Every grading UI path must call this, never touch Card fields directly.

interfaces.name: ReviewScope
interfaces.signature: enum ReviewScope: Sendable { case deck(Deck); case allDecks }

interfaces.name: SessionSummary
interfaces.signature: struct SessionSummary: Sendable { var reviewedCount: Int; var againRate: Double; var elapsed: TimeInterval; var perDeck: [DeckSessionStats] }

interfaces.name: DeckSessionStats
interfaces.signature: struct DeckSessionStats: Sendable, Identifiable { var id: UUID; var deckName: String; var reviewedCount: Int; var againRate: Double }
interfaces.notes: Preserves per-deck attribution in mixed all-decks sessions.

interfaces.name: EntitlementProviding
interfaces.signature: protocol EntitlementProviding { func currentStatus() -> EntitlementStatus }
interfaces.notes: UnlimitedEntitlementProvider is the only conformer this pass; every cap-check call site must route through this, never inline.

interfaces.name: EntitlementStatus
interfaces.signature: struct EntitlementStatus: Sendable { var isUnlimited: Bool; var maxActiveDecks: Int? }

interfaces.name: NotificationScheduler
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor final class NotificationScheduler { private(set) var authorizationStatus: UNAuthorizationStatus; func refreshAuthorizationStatus() async; func scheduleDailyReminder(at time: DateComponents) async throws; func cancelReminder() }
interfaces.notes: refreshAuthorizationStatus wired to scenePhase == .active at the App root. Notification body is a fixed generic string, never a live due count.

interfaces.name: DemoDataService
interfaces.signature: enum DemoDataService { @MainActor static func seed(context: ModelContext, clock: Clock); @MainActor static func purge(context: ModelContext) }
interfaces.notes: purge deletes every isDemo==true Deck/Card/ReviewLogEntry, verifiable by a zero-count fetch afterward.

interfaces.name: CSVImportCoordinator
interfaces.signature: @MainActor final class CSVImportCoordinator { func loadPreview(fileURL: URL, targetDeck: Deck, context: ModelContext) async throws -> CSVParseResult; func commit(_ result: CSVParseResult, targetDeck: Deck, context: ModelContext) throws -> Int }
interfaces.notes: loadPreview hands off to CSVParser.parse off-main; commit is the only step touching ModelContext for writes.

interfaces.name: DebugClockOverride
interfaces.signature: enum DebugClockOverride { #if DEBUG static func resolveClock(from arguments: [String]) -> Clock? #endif }
interfaces.notes: Parses -RecallClockOffsetDays N launch argument, used only by RecallAppUITests to automate the day-boundary/due-computation integration proof; compiled out of Release entirely via #if DEBUG.

interfaces.name: AppSettingsStore
interfaces.signature: @Observable @MainActor final class AppSettingsStore { var reminderEnabledIntent: Bool; var reminderTime: DateComponents; var demoDataEnabled: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Backed by @AppStorage/UserDefaults, not SwiftData; reminderEnabledIntent is user intent only, never conflated with NotificationScheduler.authorizationStatus.

interfaces.name: SM2Engine.previewOutcomes
interfaces.signature: enum SM2Engine { static func previewOutcomes(current: CardSchedule, clock: Clock) -> [Grade: CardSchedule] }
interfaces.notes: Computes all four grade outcomes without mutation; feeds both VoiceOver labels and the ReviewGradeRow per-button interval-preview caption from one source.
